design_rationale:
TASK 1 WORKLOG / DOSSIER — cash_pickup_transfers (Paloma Remit, Cash Pickup)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 4, 6, 5]. Occupied by task 0: cash_ext_shortfall_reissue_window, cash_ext_shortfall_credit and tools choose_shortfall_reissue_92bb83b1, book_shortfall_credit_cb14652e (incorrect-amount remedy space). Claimed here: the expired-pickup / name-correction space — cash_ext_reactivation_fee (USER pay_reactivation_fee_6d9bfacd, 5 factors), cash_ext_reactivation_window (AGENT reactivate_expired_pickup_d4e94bda, 6), cash_ext_correction_fee (USER pay_name_correction_fee_e426b8ef, 4), cash_ext_correction_extension (AGENT record_name_correction_726c5192, root, 5). No later task remains (M=2); together the two tasks cover all six extended policies with disjoint scopes. The spelling-only gate of base name correction (authority mixed over one key, unsatisfiable mechanically) is superseded in cash_ext_correction_extension by an accent-insensitive restatement, which this world exercises: 'Maria Jose Cuxil Ajanel' -> 'María Josefa Cuxil Ajanel' is 2 counted characters only because the accent is ignored.

[Why a good test] The customer only asks to fix his mother's name. The correction's own rule says (state form) that its extension waits on the pickup standing reactivated and that it is not recorded until its fee charge stands; the records show the pickup expired (2026-08-24) and no fee charges; the reactivation rule says it is not made until the reactivation fee charge stands; the correction-fee rule says that fee is fixed only after the reactivation fee charge stands. The agent must discover this diamond (reactivation fee -> {reactivation, correction fee} -> correction), hand two payments to the customer, and compute four multi-factor values on four different handling-time worlds.

[Problem-tree card] root cash_ext_correction_extension. Edges: (1) root -> cash_ext_reactivation_window, value_input, gate days_left, state: "On a pickup that has expired, the days a name correction adds to the pickup window are fixed only after the pickup stands reactivated, with its reactivation count raised and its last day of collection no earlier than the day of the correction." (only the reactivation raises the count); (2) root -> cash_ext_correction_fee, state_gate, gate cash_ledger.fee_type, state, negated: "A name correction beyond the free corrections is not recorded until the transfer's ledger carries the name-correction fee charge numbered with that correction's number." (only the correction-fee payment writes that charge); (3) cash_ext_reactivation_window -> cash_ext_reactivation_fee, state_gate, gate cash_ledger.fee_type, negated: "An expired pickup is not made collectable again until the transfer's ledger carries the reactivation fee charge numbered with that reactivation's number."; (4) cash_ext_correction_fee -> cash_ext_reactivation_fee, value_input, gate bundle_share_pct, affirmative: "On a pickup that has expired, a name-correction fee is fixed only after the transfer's ledger carries the reactivation fee charge for the reactivation that pickup awaits." Each sentence: ordering connective, record-visible state, no tool/id/code token, scope 'on a pickup that has expired' / 'beyond the free corrections' as in condition; directions mixed (fees are 'fixed only after', recordings and releases are 'not ... until'). Falsity at opening: initial_state.cash_transfers.8819ecc0-0dba-4391-a61c-b558f43ec351.status = expired, reactivation_count = 0, pickup_expiry_date = 2026-08-23; ledger holds only funds f3b4f249-3e3a-4676-beb9-719e99c814f3 and transfer fee ab8b02fd-d7d7-4274-9bad-64749726a38c. Order: reactivation fee (11) -> reactivation (13) and correction fee (15), commuting (swap run: same values and terminal hash) -> correction (17). Value edges 2 of 3 prerequisite problems. Deletion sensitivity: skip 13 -> extension 107 instead of 59; skip 11 -> correction fee 4.30 instead of 1.80 (and missing reactivation charge); skip 15 -> missing correction charge, fees_held 8.08 vs 9.88. user_scenario never mentions expiry, reactivation, fees or windows.

[Base-invariant card] step 11 / 15 (cash_fee_charged): cash_evt_pricing, cash_evt_name_correction, cash_evt_expiry_and_reactivation — no gate applies to a fee charge (policy_scope). step 13 (cash_pickup_reactivated): reactivation_window — anchor 'it expired', anchor_source cash_transfers.expired_date = 2026-08-24, duration variants.reactivation_window_days = 30 (Express), calendar days, inclusive, not_after: last on-time day 2026-09-23; 2026-09-18 inside (25 days); reactivation_cap — reactivation_count 0 < max 1. step 17 (cash_name_corrected + cash_recipient_name_updated): correctable_status — status ready_for_pickup established by step 13; correction_cap — one recorded correction (c3c25bd3-eb23-4511-a55d-a3f2470a0ee2) + this one = 2 <= max 2; spelling_only retired by the declared overwrite and replaced by the accent-insensitive sentence (2 counted characters <= 2).

[Business-object card] Target transfer 8819ecc0-0dba-4391-a61c-b558f43ec351 (PC-360724-35562, Express, GT-GTQ, 650.00, recipient the mother). Excluded: the brother's paid-out transfer 9372d40e-897d-4d49-8fe4-0ff55f0a00b3 and its ledger; the wallet transfers (evidence only); the 2025-09-11 wallet credit (12 whole months back). Fee charges are numbered by reactivation (1) and correction (2) and attach to the transfer by cash_transfer_id.

[Factor cards] reactivation fee 3.09 (standard 4.99): network share 60% (one cash-out refusal; the ID refusal does not count; baseline -> 5.09), lateness charge METHOD per-day accrual / flat / none (25 days > 21 -> 25 x 0.05 = 1.25; baseline none -> 1.84), loyalty 0.50 Silver (-> 3.59), tenure 0.50 Enhanced 49 months, cross-difficulty account, single record (-> 3.59), principal relief 0.15 (650.00; -> 3.24). reactivated window 22 (standard 30): base METHOD per-day shortening beyond 7 grace days / flat 7-day shortening / full window (25 days late -> 30 - 18 = 12; baseline -> 40), network 4 (-> 18), loyalty 2 (-> 20), tenure 2 (-> 20), corrections 1 (-> 21), principal 1 (-> 21). correction fee 1.80 (standard 5.00): bundle 50% multi-source (reactivation charge AND ID refusal; -> 4.30), lateness charge METHOD per-started-week accrual beyond the 15 middle days / flat / none (56 days -> 6 started weeks x 0.05 = 0.30; -> 1.50), loyalty 0.40 (-> 2.20), wallet 0.60 cross-difficulty wallet history, 7 credits (-> 2.40). correction extension 59 (standard 0): extension METHOD — selection (larger of top-up and days lost, two or more name refusals) / compensation (top-up plus days lost since the refusal, one refusal) / top-up alone (one ID refusal -> 10 + 49 = 59; top-up alone -> 10), history 14 (-> 49), loyalty 5 (-> 54), tenure 6 (-> 53), waiting 7 (-> 52); days_left 22 from the reactivation enters the top-up, guarantee 32. The only multi-source factor of the task is correction_bundle_share (two records: a ledger charge and a case refusal); the tenure factors read one sender-account row and are single-source. Rewards-tier factors read the Rewards membership, which no difficulty claims, so they carry no cross_difficulty label; the task's cross-difficulty factors are the account tenure factors and the wallet discount.

[Overrides] reactivation fee supersedes 'and carries reactivation_fee_usd as fee_type reactivation_fee with fee_seq equal to the new reactivation_count when that fee is above 0.00.' (amount now a factor computation; the numbering is kept); window supersedes 'Reactivation sets available_date to the reactivation date and pickup_expiry_date to that date plus pickup_window_days,'; correction fee supersedes the free/fee sentence; extension supersedes the spelling-only sentence and 'the Pickup Number and pickup window do not change.'.

[Seed rationale] customer + Enhanced account (tenure) + mother saved with the old misspelling and brother with a Tigo Money wallet + expired transfer and paid-out brother transfer + 5 cash ledger rows + 3 cases (correction 1, ID refusal, cash-out refusal) + Silver Rewards membership + 8 wallet transfers with 24 ledger rows (7 inside the window). All 47 seeded rows are read by gold reads (replay closure 47/47). Automatic clauses: expiry already happened (status expired); refusals 2 < 3 (no hold); no refund is owed while the customer chooses reactivation inside the window; caches match ledgers.

[Persona] Esteban Cuxil Ajanel, short-spoken; opens with the name fix only; credentials and the exact ID name on request; agrees to steps and approves charges handed to him; closes when told the name is corrected.

[Standard solution] reads 0-9; unlock/call pay_reactivation_fee_6d9bfacd(transfer, 1, 3.09) by the customer; unlock/call reactivate_expired_pickup_d4e94bda(transfer, 22); unlock/call pay_name_correction_fee_e426b8ef(transfer, 2, 1.80) by the customer; unlock/call record_name_correction_726c5192(transfer, 'María Josefa Cuxil Ajanel', 59) -> last day 2026-12-08.

[Verification output] verify harness (handling-time recompute with the real tools, per-factor baseline substitution, prerequisite skips): reactivation fee 3.09 (5.09/1.84/3.59/3.59/3.24, ALL 4.99); window 22 (40/18/20/20/21/21, ALL 30); correction fee 1.80 (4.30/1.50/2.20/2.40, ALL 5.00); extension 59 (10/49/54/53/52, ALL 0); edge skips: extension 59 vs 107; window substitution W = 7/22/25/30 -> 74/59/56/51, correction fee 1.80 vs 4.30; swap of steps 12-13 and 14-15: identical hash and values. Gates: see worklog round 2.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the rule prose, schemas and reads: expired transfer + correction's two prerequisite sentences -> reactivation and correction fee; reactivation's sentence -> reactivation fee; correction fee's sentence -> reactivation fee first; values 3.09, 22, 1.80, 59 as above. Matches gold.

[Round 2 revisions — audit policy_task/cash_pickup_transfers]
- T1-F1 / F-1 (RED, mislabelled method factors): symptom — the four 'method' factors (reactivation lateness x1.4/x1.2/x1, reactivated base ceil(30 x 0.5/0.75/1), correction lateness x1.2/x1.1/x1, gap multiplier 1.5/1.25/1) swapped a constant inside one formula. Change — each replaced by a factor whose tiers apply different algorithms: reactivation_lateness_charge (per-day accrual / flat charge / none, added to the network-shared fee), reactivated_lateness_base (per-day shortening beyond grace days / flat shortening / full window), correction_lateness_charge (per-started-week accrual / flat charge / none), correction_gap_method (larger-of selection with a minimum / day count excluding the last day / plain count). Rules, compute, compute_basis, ladders, baselines and params rewritten in step. Re-run: gold 3.04/25/2.00/9 -> 3.09/22/1.90/11; every factor still moves the result; baselines unchanged (4.99/30/5.00/0). Propagated to gold args, computations, tracing, business effects, prerequisite_closure figures, this dossier.
- T1-O1: tenure factors no longer called multi-source anywhere in this dossier or the factor traces.
- P-1: edge C effect text generalised (ID-mismatch or plain bundle share). P-2: edge C condition widened to 'at least one reactivation fee charge' to match the binding, keeping the expired-pickup reading.
- O-1: Rewards-tier factors relabelled cross_difficulty: null.

[Round 3 revisions — audit revision_2]
- T1-F1 / F-1 rev2 (RED, correction_gap_method): symptom — its tiers were max(7, g - L) / max(0, g - L + 1) / max(0, g - L), one formula with a floor and a one-day offset. Change — replaced by correction_guarantee_anchor, whose tiers place the guarantee clock at different anchors: after two or more name refusals the guarantee runs from the later of the current last day and the correction day and the days lost since the latest name refusal are added; after one refusal it runs from the later of the current last day and the correction day (the whole guarantee is added beyond the current last day, plus any days already passed); with none it runs from the correction day (top-up of the days left). Rule, compute (gap), compute_basis, ladder and edge D effect updated. Re-run: extension 11 -> 32 (anchor baseline 10, other factors 18/27/26/25, ALL 0); edge D skip 58 vs 32.
- O-4 (correction lateness charge not monotone across 45/46 days): the per-started-week accrual now counts weeks beyond the middle (15) days at 0.05 per week, so at 46-50 days it equals the flat 0.25 and rises from there. Correction fee 1.90 -> 1.80 (sensitivities 4.30/1.50/2.20/2.40).
- Propagated to gold args (steps 15, 17), computations, tracing, business effects, prerequisite_closure figures (fees_held 9.88; skips 58 and 4.30) and this dossier; the swap of steps 12-13 and 14-15 was re-run.

[Round 4 revisions — audit revision_3]
- N-1 / T1-C1 (RED, edge D reduced to a state gate): symptom — under the round-3 anchor tiers with an ID refusal on record, the extension read the days left only as MX(0, -days_left), so any reactivated window gave 32. Change — the extension method keeps three different algorithms but every tier now reads the days left through the top-up (guarantee less days left): two or more name refusals -> the larger of the top-up and the days lost since the latest refusal (selection); one refusal -> the top-up plus the days lost given back (compensation, a new record input); none -> the top-up alone. Factor renamed correction_extension_method; rule sentence, compute gap, compute_basis, ladder and edge D effect updated. Re-run: extension 59; method baseline 10; edge D skip 107; window substitution 7/22/25/30 -> 74/59/56/51, so the reactivated window value reaches the root again (two value-carrying edges: C and D).
- F-1 (all rounds) stays closed: the new factor's tiers differ in algorithm and inputs (larger-of selection, additive compensation from the refusal date, plain top-up), not in a swapped constant. O-4 untouched (correction fee 1.80).
user_scenario:
You are Esteban Cuxil Ajanel, 35, a warehouse shift supervisor in Dallas who sends money to his family in Guatemala. You are direct and a bit impatient on the phone, you talk in short sentences, and you apologise once if you sound short with the agent.

What you want: in July you sent your mother 650 dollars through Paloma to pick up in cash near Mixco. When she went to collect it at the counter at the Farmacia Batres in Mixco they turned her away because the name on the transfer did not match her ID. You call to get her name fixed on that transfer so she can go and collect the money. That is what you say when the call starts: your mom was turned away because the name on your transfer to her is wrong, and you need it fixed so she can pick it up. You do not know Paloma's rules and you never suggest steps, amounts, dates or what has to happen first.

What you say only when the agent asks: your mobile number is 2145550151; your date of birth is 1990-11-27; your ZIP code is 75217; if the agent wants one more item, the last four characters of your ID are 3T61. The confirmation number on your receipt is PC-360724-35562, the 650-dollar transfer to your mother. When the agent asks for your mother's name exactly as it appears on her ID, you spell it out carefully: María Josefa Cuxil Ajanel, with the accent on the i of María. If asked, you remember that in July someone at Paloma already fixed one letter of her last name, but the counter still said it did not match.

How you react: if the agent explains that something has to be done or paid on the transfer for the name to be fixed and asks whether to go ahead, you say yes, go ahead, you want this done today. If the agent gives you a charge to approve yourself in the app, you approve it right away with exactly the details the agent tells you and read back what the app shows; you do not question small amounts. If the agent tells you about new dates for your mother to collect, you note them and say you will call her. Once the agent tells you the name on the transfer has been corrected, you thank them, say you will tell your mom to bring her ID, and end the call.
